Hi! I'm completely new to this and don't know where to start, can you guide me?
Welcome, it is lovely to have you here. We are a British premium fashion brand offering colourful, timeless clothing for women, men and children, and I can guide you step by step.
A great first step is to set up and sign in to your account:
On desktop: select the person icon in the top‑right, then choose Log in.
On mobile: open the three‑line menu in the top‑left, then select Sign in.
Enter your email address and choose Continue. We will email you a 6‑digit login code. Keep the page open, enter the code, then select Submit to log in.
If the email has not arrived within 10 minutes, please check your junk or spam folder.
